name: WBJet-HelloTap
author: dhirajsharma

sections.description:
Are you missing out on potential customers? Make it incredibly easy for your visitors to connect with you. WBJet-HelloTap adds a professional, floating contact button to your site, allowing visitors to start a WhatsApp chat or call your business with a single click. Turn your website traffic into paying customers!

For more information and other plugins, visit our website at WBJet.com.

Key Features:

  • WhatsApp & Call Buttons: Provide instant contact options for your visitors.
  • Highly Customizable: Match your brand perfectly. Customize colors, position (left/right), button text, and more.
  • Device Visibility Control: Choose to show buttons on desktop, tablet, or mobile devices—or all three.
  • Multiple WhatsApp Link Types: Use a simple link or a pre-filled message to make it even easier for customers.
  • Advanced Styling Options: Select from multiple button styles (Classic, Circular, Modern, etc.) and fine-tune margins and Z-index for perfect placement.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built for performance. WBJet-HelloTap won’t slow down your website.
  • Easy to Use: No coding required! A simple and intuitive settings page makes configuration a breeze.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wbjet-hellotap directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > WBJet HelloTap to configure the plugin and bring your contact buttons to life!
sections.faq:
Can I customize the button colors and style?

Yes! You have full control over the colors, text, and style of both the WhatsApp and Call buttons from the settings panel.

Can I control where the buttons appear?

Absolutely. You can set the buttons to appear on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices independently. You can also adjust their position on the screen.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

Not at all. WBJet-HelloTap is designed to be lightweight and optimized for speed.

Can I use a pre-filled message for WhatsApp?

Yes, you can configure a default message that will automatically appear when a user clicks the WhatsApp button, making it even faster for them to contact you.
